<2.4L Engine> or C-63 <3.0L Engine> terminal 122.

Refer to P.23A-349, Transaxle Control.
Q: Is the switch operating properly?
YES : Go to Step 25.
NO : Replace the shift switch assembly. Refer to P.23A-
349, Transaxle Control.
STEP 29. Check connector C-65 at shift switch assembly 
for damage.
Q: Is the connector in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 30.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness
